hypothesis: The frozen daily expanding Ridge alpha-100 procedure generalizes beyond Chicago: across five prespecified unseen stations it improves pooled MAE versus persistence by at least 5%, maintains pooled absolute bias at or below 1C, and has a positive date-cluster-bootstrap lower confidence bound for paired MAE reduction.
station_selection_policy: The five stations are fixed for climate diversity and major-airport continuity before their hourly values or target outcomes are downloaded. No station may be removed based on results. A technically unavailable identifier may be replaced only before any other station is scored, with the replacement and reason recorded as a protocol deviation.

window.timestamp_semantics: NOAA LCDv2 local standard time; no DST adjustment
window.decision_cutoff: 18:00 local standard time on the calendar day before the target

frozen_forecasting_procedure.eligibility: At least 18 distinct temperature hours from 00:00 through 18:00 LST on target-minus-one day

bootstrap.unit: target_date across all stations present on that date

decision_rule.all_data_quality_gates_pass: Run the frozen station-specific expanding walk-forward once and evaluate every confirmation gate.
decision_rule.any_data_quality_gate_fails: Do not score any station; report the preregistered cohort as blocked or failed without station substitution based on outcomes.
decision_rule.all_confirmation_gates_pass: Accept cross-city generalization for the weather-only point-forecast stage and proceed to probabilistic modeling on a separately designed split.
decision_rule.any_confirmation_gate_fails: Reject generalization; report every station and do not tune on the confirmation cohort.
